answer: Each agent’s influence can be capped by a unique-person credential issued after an in-person liveness check, with credentials expiring and being revalidated periodically. A grove of fabricated accounts then needs a separate real person for every extra vote, rather than merely more scripts; that makes scaling costly and exposes operators who recruit or pay credential holders. The pulse of activity and a saffron-colored trust marker may guide review, but neither substitutes for the credential, so attackers cannot cheaply manufacture legitimacy by generating traffic.
